title: Matt Damon's Water.org reaches 1 million people in Latin America through Ripple partnership
summary_full: Water.org, co-founded by Matt Damon and Gary White, works tirelessly to combat the global water crisis. Through a partnership with Ripple, they have secured innovative financing solutions for families in Latin America. Ripple has committed $6 million to support WaterCredit, enabling affordable loans for water access. This initiative has already empowered over 1 million people with safe water, as they strive to reach 200 million by 2030.
